Name: Child Needs You
Author: logNest
Description:
[b]Supported languages: [/b]English (English description below), 简体中文

[size=5][b]Child Needs You 孩子需要你[/b][/size]

现在，你的孩子可能会在一天中的随机时间表达需求：想喝奶，想吃冰淇淋，或者只是想你了。
需求得到满足前，孩子会一直哭。满足需求后，就会重新露出笑容啦～
如果伴侣也在场，还会有相应的反应对话。

每次亲自满足需求，都能增加 25 点孩子好感度；没能满足也不会受到惩罚。

[size=4][b]（1.2.0 新增）伴侣帮忙照顾[/b][/size]
伴侣和孩子都在家时，空闲的伴侣会主动帮忙照顾孩子。
伴侣照顾不消耗物品，也不增加孩子好感度。

可通过 Generic Mod Config Menu 或编辑 [b]config.json[/b] 配置需求出现的概率和哭声音量，以及开关通知、音效、伴侣主动照顾和反应对话。

[*][b]HaveMoreKids[/b][/*]
[/list]

[line]

[left][size=5][b]English[/b][/size][/left]

Each day, your child may let you know what they need at a random time. They might want some milk, an ice cream, or simply miss you.
They'll keep crying until their needs are met, then start smiling again!
If your spouse is nearby, they'll have something to say, too.

Meeting a need yourself adds 25 friendship points with that child. There is no penalty for leaving a need unmet.

[size=4][b](New in 1.2.0) Spouse care[/b][/size]
When your spouse and child are both at home, your spouse can step in to help if they're free. 
Spouse care uses no items and doesn't increase friendship with your child.

Use Generic Mod Config Menu or edit [b]config.json[/b] to control how often needs arise and how loud the crying is. You can also toggle notifications, sound effects, spouse care, and spouse reaction dialogue.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]LittleNPCs[/b] (tested with [b]The Farmer's Children[/b]): Children who grow into NPCs still have needs, but [b]no longer cry[/b].[/*]
[*][b]HaveMoreKids[/b][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.7 or later[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and lets you adjust the settings in-game.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract ChildNeedsYou into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
